translations.web: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
translations.bsb: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
translations.kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
translations.asv: but now do ye also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, railing, shameful speaking out of your mouth:
